mapper.select: SELECT e.no,e.title,e.open_date,e.close_date,e.instructor_id, NVL(e.time_limit,120) AS time_limit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduled_exam_map WHERE exam_no=e.no) AS question_count FROM scheduled_exam e WHERE e.instructor_id=#{instructorId} ORDER BY e.open_date DESC

SELECT no,title,score,type,theme FROM exam_question WHERE no IN
#{questionNo}
